thread:
maria: quick sync — postmortem for yesterday's metrics drift is in: https://rwd/internal/postmortems/metrics-drift. proposing a 2-week "reconciliation sprint" to close the remaining action items (missing spans, aggregator skew, ETL lag). owners below, pls ack and call out timeline constraints. :calendar:

ash: ack. i can own ETL lag root cause + backfill. estimate: 3 day triage, then 4 day fix + 1 day smoke tests, then backfill window. target complete by 2025-11-10. need help validating backfill safety.

devon: i'll take aggregator logic (bad cardinality after dedupe change). root cause: we switched to left_join dedupe in release but that changed group keys when sampling enabled. reproduction snippet:```sql
-- simplified repro
select service, count(distinct trace_id) as traces
from spans_vw
where ts >= '{{window_start}}'
group by service;
```
If sampling flag is on, join drops traces for overlapping spans. plan: patch by EOD Fri, add unit test, canary for 24h.

jess: will own sampling config + tests. i can add an integration test that runs against small synthetic dataset and asserts invariant: sum(traces_by_service) after sampling == expected +-1%. will also add alert for sudden drops.

samir: suggest we add a runbook entry and a monthly recurrence check in observability for this family of issues (missing spans / aggregation regressions). also propose a throttled nightly reconciliation job that verifies aggregate totals across raw vs processed pipelines and emits a drift metric.

maria: concrete action list (owners + due dates):
- ash: ETL lag fix + backfill plan, due 2025-11-10
- devon: aggregator patch + unit tests + canary, due 2025-11-07
- jess: sampling integration tests + alerting, due 2025-11-07
- samir: runbook + nightly reconciliation job spec, due 2025-11-12
please link PRs -> postmortem doc and add a short notes section to the runbook when done. i'll set recurring weekly check-ins for the two-week sprint. :spiral_calendar:

ash: created ticket and started a private branch. question: backfill window — do we run region-by-region to reduce load? i think yes. any objections?

devon: region-by-region sounds safer. let's add a low-traffic window for initial backfill.

jess: agree. also let's gate the alert so it doesn't page during the controlled backfill; we can mute/pause then re-enable. add a test to ensure alert resumes.

Ticket-bot: created INC-51234 for ETL-lag-fix, created INC-51235 for aggregator-patch, created INC-51236 for sampling-tests, created INC-51237 for reconciliation-job.

maria: love the ticketization. last items: please add an expected rollback plan in each PR (how to revert canary), and post a short note in #eng-oncall about potential pager noise. i'll run the first check-in tomorrow 10:30am PT. thanks all. :thumbsup:
